limitations: Identifier scope is not complete phenotype validation or whole-record signoff.
Azoxystrobin co-occurrence in PMID:26596626 does not establish an allele-specific effect; the parent is also reported resistant. Source biology is retained, not independently certified.
The remaining two OA papers retain unresolved locus crosswalks; no new allele join was inferred.
UniProt alternative-sequence flags are not experimental-allele evidence.
The source V592 label is retained; the paper uses Vd592, distinct from reference VdLs.17.
No new alteration, subject label, protein, gene, TaxID, genome, sample or activity was assigned.
EC50, IC50 and growth/zone observations are not converted into MIC or clinical classifications.
Metadata-only export: no protocols, sequences, primers, constructs or enhancement designs.
No NCBI requests, outreach, terms work, source adoption or GitHub mutations.
The whole-corpus primary investigation remains incomplete.
